'''Lucky's''' was a casino owned by an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] nicknamed [[Lucky (Ortolan)|Lucky]] located in [[Point Nadir]]. It was famous for the card and dice games that took place there. High stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] games were often held there and drew in many skilled gamblers. While the casino wasn't affiliated with a particular criminal syndicate, it did pay protection money to the Hutts.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>

It was also known for its high quality food. Lucky used the best ingredients and his dining room overlooking the sabacc arena was a popular destination.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
